title: feat(plugin-detail): the record tab row puts related lists with records first and folds empty ones into the dropdown
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4ogbjKVSM14fvqoAK6BYVn)_

Fixes #28469

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录页标签行里，有数据的关联先排、空关联（计数为 0）一律收进「+N ▾」，下拉里在溢出页签之后、隐藏页签之前，用分隔线隔开并以灰色显示 0；计数还在加载时，关联页签先不上行，计数到齐后一次性按最终顺序出现。
- 为什么改：页签行和右栏说的是同一批关联，右栏早已把空关联折成一行（#27524 Target 2），页签行却让空列表占着可见位、把有数据的列表挤进下拉。
- 风险与回滚：只改渲染顺序，存储的 `record.related.arrangement` 形状与内容都不变；读不到计数（拒绝/无数据源）的列表仍按读者排列留在原位；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`（加载期暂不上行的那段 filter），`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordTabRow.ts`（分区与活动页签规则），`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx`（下拉分组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/recordTabRow-28469.test.ts packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordTabRow.recordsFirst-28469.test.tsx`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The record page's tab row now applies the rule the right column already applies to its panels (#27524 Target 2): related lists with records first, empty ones out of the way.

- **Stable partition** (`partitionRecordTabsByRecords`, `synth/recordTabRow.ts`). After Overview and Activity, the panels whose count is not `0` keep the reader's arrangement order among themselves; the panels whose count is `0` follow, in the same order. An unknown count (`null` / absent) is not `0`.
- **Empty tabs never take a slot** (`arrangeRecordTabRow` + `RecordTabRow`'s new `emptyTabs` prop). They are never row candidates, so the width computation is unchanged and runs over the non-empty tabs only. They count toward the dropdown (`alwaysInDropdown`), so a row with room for everything still shows 「+N ▾」 when an empty list exists.
- **Dropdown order**: overflowed non-empty tabs, then a separator and the empty tabs (`data-record-tab-empty`, muted face, count chip in `text-muted-foreground`, the tone of `RelatedListEmptyFold`'s panel line), then the hidden panels' tabs as before. No label on the empty group, so no i18n key.
- **Active tab stays visible** (Target 3). An active empty tab (a `?related=` deep link) is appended after the row candidates, so `layoutRecordTabRow` draws it in the row's last slot; it leaves the dropdown.
- **Nothing stored changes** (Target 4). The partition is computed per render from `resolved.order`; `record.related.arrangement` is not written.
- **No tab moves after the row draws** (Target 2, read by its intent; see Acceptance notes). While the panels' first count set is still out (`useRelatedCounts` state `pending`, the moment the right column draws its count skeletons), the panel tabs wait off the row; they appear once, already partitioned, when the set settles. The active tab is always drawn during that window. A list that is never counted (no data source, a refused read: state `uncounted`) keeps its arrangement place, as Target 2 rules.

`RecordTabRow` / `layoutRecordTabRow` are package-internal (not exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s entry), so Clause-② is `no`.

## Why

HotCRM contact John Smith (800 px drawer) showed two empty 线索 lists on the row while 工单 2 · 合同 1 · 报价单 2 · 营销活动成员 3 sat in 「+6」, and the right column on the same record said 「还有 4 个空关联」. One rule for both surfaces; the reader's drag still decides the order among lists with records; no new setting or metadata key.

## Verification

Head `13333cdf` (branch merged with `origin/main` 35b178bd0 before the final runs).

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- New `synth/__tests__/recordTabRow-28469.test.ts` (6 tests): counts `[7, 0, 0, 2, 1, 2, 3]` in arrangement order at a 500 px row → row `overview, timeline, attendee, case, contract`, dropdown `quote, campaign_member, lead.converted_contact, lead.duplicate_contact, opportunity`; empty never on a 2000 px row; partition stable; `null`/absent stays in place; active empty tab in the last slot (narrow and wide); all-empty / all-full.
- New `__tests__/RecordTabRow.recordsFirst-28469.test.tsx` (7 tests): dropdown order with both separators and the muted chip; active empty tab on the row; through `RecordPageColumns`: counts seeded into `RelatedCountStore` the way the page payload does (`RelatedCountStore.seed`) draw the final order on the first render, a MutationObserver on the tab list records 0 child-list changes after, and `find` is never called; counts read after the page draws: the row is Overview · Activity while the set is out and every row drawn on the way is a prefix of the final one; a refused count keeps Tasks first; an active tab restored from `?related=` is drawn while the set is out.
- Updated `RecordPageColumns.tabRow-27524.test.tsx`: the `note.parent_id` (count 0) tab is now in the dropdown (`+2` with the hidden panel), not on the row.

- Active-empty rule removed in `arrangeRecordTabRow`: 2 red (unit + component).
- Pending hold removed in `RecordPageColumns` (`resolved.order.filter(...)` → `resolved.order`): 2 red (the prefix test and the active-tab-while-pending test).
- Active exception removed from the hold: 1 red (the active-tab-while-pending test).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head derived 34 families; all 34 run with exit 0, and `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Live measurement (Acceptance 2 and 3)</summary>

Stack: `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --fresh`) + the Console from this branch's source (vite, proxy to that backend). Account "Nimbus Holdings" with Activities 3 · Contacts 0 · Leads 0 · Opportunities 2 (arrangement order Activities, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities). The record page opens with one `POST /api/v1/data/crm_account/:id/page`; no separate count reads.

Tab-row states logged by a MutationObserver from navigation start (ms since load):

On `main`'s code (1440 px):
```
8681  overview | timeline | Activities | Contacts | Leads | Opportunities      (no counts: payload in flight)
9156  overview | timeline 1 | Activities | Contacts | Leads | Opportunities
9386  overview | timeline 1 | Activities 3 | Contacts 0 | Leads 0 | Opportunities 2
```
With the literal Target 2 rule (first commit of this branch, 1440 px), the two empty tabs left the row ~700 ms after first draw:
```
7829  overview | timeline | Activities | Contacts | Leads | Opportunities
8342  overview | timeline 1 | Activities | Contacts | Leads | Opportunities
8560  overview | timeline 1 | Activities 3 | Opportunities 2 | +2
```
This branch's head (1440 px; 800 px identical):
```
9940   overview | timeline
10491  overview | timeline 1
10649  overview | timeline 1 | Activities 3 | Opportunities 2 | +2      dropdown: Contacts 0 (empty), Leads 0 (empty)
```

Screenshots (before/after, page at 1440 px, page at 800 px, the list's record drawer at 1440 px): project folder `ui-seat-1/r2026-10-31b/out/28469-shots/`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Target 2 is implemented by its intent, not its literal rule.** The card assumed the counts are known at first paint because they come with the page payload. Measured on the live Console (log above): the tab row first draws while that payload is still in flight, so every count is pending; under the literal rule ("a count not known yet counts as non-empty, the tab stays where the arrangement puts it") the empty tabs drew on the row and then left it ~200–700 ms later, failing Acceptance 2. The seat ruled the route (2026-11-01): while the first count set is pending, the panel tabs wait off the row and appear once in final order; the active tab is always drawn; a list that is never counted (refused / no source) keeps its arrangement place, which is the literal rule for that case. Tabs only appear, the same instant the right column's panels resolve; none moves or leaves.
- **Acceptance 3** asked for HotCRM contact John Smith at 800 px drawer and 1440 px page. HotCRM is a sibling repo pinned to the published 18.2.0 packages, so the same before/after was taken on `examples/app-crm` as the dispatch order allows: page at 1440 px and 800 px, and the list's record drawer at 1440 px. The before shots are `main`'s three source files restored over the running Console (vite HMR), the after shots this branch.
- A body table open in place still takes its tab after the lists with records and before an active empty one; it never has a count, so it is never folded.
- Files shared with in-flight neighbours: none of the declared neighbour files is touched.
